en.title: Resident Evil Star Austin Abrams Calls Film's Ending 'Risky and Gutsy'
en.summary: Austin Abrams, star of the new Resident Evil film, has opened up about the divisive conclusion to the hit video game adaptation. He describes the ending as a bold and surprising choice that he ultimately admired.
en.body:
The world of Raccoon City has once again been plunged into chaos with the latest adaptation of **Resident Evil**, and star **Austin Abrams** is ready to discuss its most talked-about element: the ending. Abrams, who portrays Bryan, a medical courier caught in the heart of a viral outbreak, found director **Zach Cregger**'s conclusion to be a masterstroke of daring filmmaking.

"I was surprised by it, but I also loved that he would take that chance," Abrams shared regarding Cregger's bold finale. The film, set during events that parallel the iconic **Resident Evil 2** game from 1998 but updated for a modern era, sees Bryan navigating a city overrun by infected monsters. The ending, which Abrams found to be particularly audacious, represents a significant departure for the franchise, prioritizing narrative risk over conventional resolution.

## A Gutsy Narrative Choice

Abrams elaborated on the specific elements that made the ending stand out. The decision to steer the narrative in a direction that might surprise or even challenge viewers is something he deeply appreciated. For him, the ending wasn't just unexpected; it was a testament to the creative vision behind the project. He specifically noted the courage it took to conclude the story in such a manner, stating, "Then to have him not make it is really risky and gutsy, which is what I love about all of Zach's work."

This sentiment underscores a growing trend in blockbuster filmmaking, where creators are increasingly willing to explore more complex and less predictable narrative paths. In a landscape often dominated by formulaic conclusions, Abrams' endorsement of **Cregger**'s unconventional approach suggests a desire for more impactful and memorable storytelling, even within established franchises.

## Fan Reactions and Franchise Future

The ending of **Resident Evil** has undoubtedly sparked considerable discussion among fans, many of whom have strong attachments to the source material and its previous iterations. The surprise factor, coupled with the daring nature of the conclusion, has created a significant talking point within the community. For viewers who crave a fresh take on the beloved zombie apocalypse saga, Abrams' perspective offers a compelling reason to embrace the film's daring finale. It suggests that **Resident Evil** is aiming to carve out its own identity within the crowded horror genre.

## What's Next

With the film now released and its ending generating buzz, fans will be eager to see how this narrative direction impacts future installments in the **Resident Evil** franchise. Details regarding any potential sequels or further adaptations have not yet been announced, but the conversation around **Zach Cregger**'s bold vision is sure to influence expectations.
